an6.18:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhu saṅghena saddhiṃ.
an6.18:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā addhāna maggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamānaṃ.
an6.18:1.3: disvā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.18:1.5: ”passatha, no tumhe bhikkhave amuṃ macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamānanti”
an6.18:2.3: “macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyīvā yānayāyī vā bhoga bhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto?”ti.
an6.18:2.6: mayāpi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ, na sutaṃ
an6.18:2.7: “macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogīvā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto”ti.
an6.18:2.9: te hi so bhikkhave macche vajjhe vadhāyopanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati. tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti, na assayāyī, na rathayāyī, na yānayāyī, na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:3.2: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā
an6.18:3.3: “goghātako gāvo vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto?”ti.
an6.18:3.6: mayāpi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ, na sutaṃ:
an6.18:3.7: “goghātako gāvo vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto”ti.
an6.18:3.9: te hi so bhikkhave gāvo vajjhe vadhāyopanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati. tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:4.2: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā
an6.18:4.6: māgaviko mage vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto?”ti.
an6.18:4.9: mayāpi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ, na sutaṃ:
an6.18:4.10: “māgaviko mage vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto”ti.
an6.18:4.12: te hi so bhikkhave mage vajjhe vadhāyopanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati. tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti, na assayāyī, na rathayāyī, na yānayāyī, na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:4.13: te hi so bhikkhave tiracchānagate pāṇe vajjhe vadhāyopanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhamāno neva hatthiyāyī bhavissati, na assayāyī, na rathayāyī, na yānayāyī, na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasissati.
an6.18:4.14: ko pana vādo yaṃ manussabhūtaṃ vajjhaṃ vadhāyopanītaṃ pāpakena manasānupekkhati.
an6.18:4.15: taṃ hi tassa bhikkhave hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
an6.18:4.16: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
